bilibili.text:
1.8.7 更新（2026-10-30）

修复休息存档不出现在“自动保存”列表的问题，保留 AutoSave_ 前缀。名称跟随游戏语言，统一精确到分钟，不再带休息原因、秒数或哈希后缀：
中文：AutoSave_休息_T26_261029-2250
英文：AutoSave_Rest_T26_261029-2250

禁止覆盖旧存档；同一分钟重名且保存请求被拒绝时，会显示保存失败。

工坊已更新：https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3815557333

reddit.note: Comment posted successfully toast and permalink verified. Technical update on existing post; no added promotional link. Visitor visibility not separately tested.
reddit.text:
1.8.7 update — October 30, 2026

Fixed break saves missing from the Autosaves tab. New saves keep the AutoSave_ prefix and use a shorter name based on the game text language:
English: AutoSave_Rest_T26_261029-2250
Simplified Chinese: AutoSave_休息_T26_261029-2250

All break reasons share this format. The timestamp is now local YYMMDD-HHMM, without seconds or a hash suffix. Existing saves are never overwritten; if a duplicate name in the same minute is rejected, the panel reports a failed save.
